g.text: Page 2 of 3; all 36 predefined estimates retained across pages.
Blue circles: baseline. Orange squares: frozen sensitivity.
Marginal intervals compare estimators descriptively. Shared-source
covariance is uncalibrated; no comparative P, new BH family, or
source clearance is inferred. Original q values/exclusions are retained.
